families.label: Install from a marketplace or catalog listing under Customize > Plugins

variants.label: Browse plugins in the default marketplace and Install (Cowork mode)
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Select Browse plugins to see available plugins (default marketplace is Anthropic's official catalog)
Select a plugin and click Install
Sign in if the plugin includes a connector that needs authentication

families.label: Install from a plugin package file under Customize > Plugins

variants.label: Upload option on the Plugins page (Cowork mode)
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Select the upload option on the Plugins page

variants.label: Add plugin > Upload plugin, .zip with trust notice, installed on this device only
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Acknowledge the notice to install only plugins you trust

claude.note: Only product documenting the marketplace-catalog install path (P1); the source names Cowork mode. File install is one sentence with no trust notice.

claude-gov.note: No public marketplace; file install goes through Add plugin > Upload plugin, requires a trust acknowledgement, and applies only on the current device.
